scope: Theorem 8.2 (Phase alternative) of the manuscript “A counterexample to Hadwiger's conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-Hadwigers-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 157 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a97293542586d351), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose a marked-unit law is obtained by restricting an admissible law in Theorem 3.1 to mass at least 10−12, and ∆O ̸= 0 throughout. For all sufficiently large n, one can retain a sublaw of fixed positive relative mass, bounded below using only the early parameters, such that one of the following holds for independent draws A, B: (i) every nontrivial phase mean E(−1)uB,S(∆A)+uA,R(∆B) , (S, R) ̸= (∅, ∅), has absolute value less than .005; (ii) a componentwise cover of total dimension at most d0 covers every ∆O, and every displayed mean for which |S| = 1 or |R| = 1 is 2−Ω(N). The cover may depend on the law and on n. The constants in its dimension bound and in the relative mass bound do not depend on the later selector or channel sizes.
